## Lead Gen & CRM Enrichment
**Setup (5 min):**
1. Clearbit node: `YOUR_CLEARBIT_API_KEY` replace karo (ya Apollo/Hunter ka URL lagao)
2. Google Sheets: credential + Sheet select karo. Headers: Date, Name, Email, Phone, Company, Title, Industry, Employees, LinkedIn, Country, Source, Message, Score, Tier, Enriched
3. Slack / Telegram: credential + channel/chat ID daalo (jo na chahiye use delete karo)
4. Webhook ka Production URL apni form / Facebook / LinkedIn integration me lagao
5. Workflow ko Active karo
